answer: Each new identity must lock 25 POA for 10 epochs, and every epoch a random 10% of identities are audited by a stranger who demands a fresh signed proof of independent control. A copper-thin shell account that fails on any ledge of the audit loses half its lock, so the cost of the Nth fake rises by 12 POA of expected slashing, and karst-like networks of clones get exposed by shared failures verified on chain.
